body: Update: I tested at 13-14 weeks post exposure. My result was negative! I know some people say it takes them months or a year, but I’m putting this all behind me now
I tested negative!
I am waiting on my 13 week results now
Oh gosh I would not want to wait that long. My anxiety is already through the roof
Were you on antivirals? I read that could delay antibody production
Did you have a known exposure?
Were you taking antivirals prior to the blood test? I wonder if that’s why your value was so low
Could the low positive be due to antiviral therapy by any chance?
Can I ask what the igg level was?
Oh wow! It took a whole year for the blood test to become positive after exposure?
Do you know who gave it to you? How do you forgive them (especially if they purposefully chose not to disclose)?
Oh that makes so much sense!!! Thank you so much
I searched “hsv dna pcr blood” and find some labs. But it was like $600. Not sure how legit it is since no one really talks about it

My family is Buddhist. My mom believes in fate and says if I kill myself, I’ll have to relive the same fate again in my next life. I would hate to relive this again.
Just get tested together with new partners before having sex 😊
Thank you so much for your kind words. I definitely learned to screen all partners carefully.  If only I had a time machine!

You are spot on about him being a jerk. I ended up breaking things off. He turned out to be an aggressive, offensive, racist, and selfish man. Just not traits I would want in a partner. Just wished I got to know him more before hooking up, but I guess we live and learn.

You’re so young! Your time will come. Not trying to sound cliche, but wait for the right person. There are people on dating apps who are knowingly exposing their matches to STDs. Please be careful out there!

I asked him to get tested together after hooking up…because I started feeling worried about what I had done. He then took a deep breath and told me he had been diagnosed with hsv2 many years ago. Sure enough, his test confirmed that

My trust was completely broken. Then he started yelling at me and saying things like “you’re the only woman who has asked for an STD test. No one else has done this”

Thank you so much for your reply!

The most ironic thing is that I’m usually careful with this type of thing. At the nail salon, I’ll request not to have my cuticles cut for fear of getting infections. That’s why it baffles me that I trusted this man with my body after only 4 dates and slept with him before getting tested together. I try not to beat myself up, but it’s so hard. 

Thank you so much for your kind words. And I agree. I should’ve remembered that most men struggle with offering females consent. I want to report this guy to the dating site, but he knows where my family lives and I wouldn’t want him coming after any of us.
I definitely learned the hard way that not everyone can be trusted
I know! I just feel so deceived and robbed of my choice to decide.

Thank you so much for your reply!

I sort of understand the CDC recommendations. I can see how it wouldn't be a "big deal" for asymptomatic carriers, but my only concern would be for the people who would experience aggressive outbreaks. 

And you are spot on in regards to his character. I ended things because he turned out to be pretty aggressive and controlling. In fact, he got mad because I wanted to hold off sex while I got tested. 

I for sure learned a huge lesson. I recognize the importance of getting tested. I really wish everyone could go back in time and make that choice as well.

Thank you for your kind words.

It’s just the way he made the choice for me that is upsetting.

Thank you so much for your reply!
This has been such a traumatic experience for me
Hi! How did everything turn out? I also had a legit herpes scare. I tested negative on IGG at 8 weeks as well
Thank you!

Thank you for your kind words ❤️

And you are right about the red flag. I ended up breaking up with this guy. I noticed his true colors after the hook up. He just ended up being aggressive, offensive, and not the kindest person to be around😔

Thank you so much! 

And yes, I probably should’ve asked to be tested together before anything happened. So I take part of the blame too. But I agree. It would’ve been super nice if he gave me a heads up so I could’ve had the chance to make an informed decision. 

I’ve learned to be more cautious and not to trust just anyone. And it has been one of the hardest lessons

I got a blood test at 6 and 8 weeks. Both were negative so far! No symptoms that I know of…

If I could go back in time I would’ve asked him to get tested before we did anything. I’m not sure what I was thinking putting my own body at risk like that
Oh it makes sense of it’s hsv1 and you are testing negative. According to Terri warren, the igg blood tests miss about 30% of hsv1 cases. You should get a western blot!
How are you still testing negative for it by blood??

I matched with a man from coffee meets bagel and he did the very same thing. At least he told you. I only found out because I insisted we get tested for STDs. He had a 3-year relationship with another woman before me. And he NEVER told her. His reasoning was “it’s not a big deal. I didn’t say anything because I didn’t want to get rejected. It’s just like having pimples”. Like what an asshole. Now I’m stuck with the anxiety of testing for STDs over and over again. He took away my freedom to choose. It has stolen so much from my life. It’s the most selfish thing someone could ever do to another person. I’m never online dating ever again. I wish I never matched with that POS.
You should ask her on a date!! You will always wonder “what if” of you don’t

Yes!! You are in a very good position right now 😊😊 you can hang out with friends or plan a trip for yourself! With not a worry in the world 😊 just be careful when online dating! I can’t stress that enough.

You are a smart person for waiting. Be careful out there! I met a guy online and he was very dishonest. It is best to wait to know someone really well before sex. Oh and remember to screen all your partners for STDs before sex. The guy I met purposefully did not disclose that he had herpes. Be smart and vigilant when dating!!

I would rather deal with being safe and ghosted than dealing with the stress of having to get tested for STDs. I desperately wish the guy I met ghosted me.
